layout.desktop: Left navigation remains available; the main area shows automation tasks, recent runs, templates, and result-driven creation actions.
layout.mobile: Single-column task flow; detail and editor use modals with stacked fields and actions.

regions.name: Automation entry
regions.purpose: Help users manage reports and analysis that are generated automatically on a chosen schedule.

regions.name: Configured tasks
regions.purpose: Show tasks that will generate reports or analysis, and let users run, pause, resume, edit, or open the latest run.

regions.name: Create from current result
regions.purpose: When a user has just asked for data, carry the result summary, metrics, and dimensions into the scheduled report editor.
regions.dataPolicy: Read current data directly; do not ask the user to confirm data freshness.

regions.name: Create or edit task
regions.purpose: Collect task name, description, cadence, run time, metrics, dimensions, and notification preferences.

regions.name: Recent runs
regions.purpose: Show generated results, status, and time, and let users open run details.

regions.name: Run detail
regions.purpose: Show step timeline, errors, input, output, result file, and retry actions for a run.
regions.componentBinding: Ant Design modal + timeline + action buttons

regions.name: Notification settings
regions.purpose: Let users choose whether completion and abnormal results should notify them, and who should receive the reminder.

regions.name: Task templates
regions.purpose: Let users start common report, table merge, and tag analysis tasks from reusable prompts.

sourceRefs.title: Existing first-screen UISchema used as visual baseline

evidenceRefs.title: Scheduled report and automation task design
evidenceRefs.path: docs/design-v1/08-定时报表与自动化任务系统设计.md

recommendedActions: Create a scheduled report from the current data answer.
Run a task immediately and save the result file to assets.
Open run details to inspect steps, errors, inputs, and outputs.
Retry failed runs and keep a failure case snapshot.

statePolicy.empty: Show a clear empty state and template entry.
statePolicy.loading: Show loading rows while tasks are being read.
statePolicy.error: Keep the user's draft and show a retryable error message.
statePolicy.permission: Only show tasks and runs available to the current user.
